title: The Only Cat Known to Survive Space 🐱🚀 #Shorts
description:
On 18 October 1963, France launched Félicette, a stray tuxedo cat from Paris, on a Véronique rocket from the Sahara in Algeria. She took about 9.5 g and landed by parachute after a flight of under 20 minutes. She is still the only cat known to have flown to space and survived. We also cover how a cat's mid-air twist shaped astronaut research, why cats can't land on their feet in zero gravity, and a bonus fact about purring.
